title: introduce-policy-contracts-kms-commitment-ledger-and-residency-gate
author: Ethan Park
release_notes: Introduces Policy Contracts DSL, a KMS Commitment Ledger for auditable per-request key provenance, and a Residency Gate to enforce region-pinned KMS usage. Backward-compatible rollout with feature flag and staged migration. See docs for operator steps.
description: Context and motivation: Customers operating under jurisdictional controls asked for stronger, auditable guarantees that (1) requests that claim a region-bound residency are actually served with region-anchored CMKs, (2) operator principles cannot bypass tenant-scoped RBAC policies, and (3) audit trails contain verifiable cryptographic markers tying requests to KMS commitments. This PR implements three coordinated pieces: (A) a lightweight Policy Contracts DSL and compiler that lets product and compliance own high-level contracts (e.g., "Tenant must use CMK in eu-west-1 for classification=restricted") and compiles into RBACv2 assertions and enforcer rules; (B) a KMS Commitment Ledger service that records authoritative, append-only KMS assignment decisions per request (signed by the enforcer) and surfaces a compact proof token that is attached to audit events; (C) a Residency Gate enforcement shim that runs in the mux layer to block/redirect requests that violate region pin constraints and surface clear error codes for callers. Implementation summary: - New package rbac-policy-bundle/policy_contracts: DSL spec (YAML first-class), compiler, and unit tests; includes example contracts for tenant residency, operator-scoped denylists, and service-level allowances. - Enforcer integration: authz/enforcer now consumes compiled policy contracts at startup (and supports runtime refresh). When the enforcer binds a KMS choice to a request it issues a KMS Commitment entry (ledger client) and returns a compact commitment token (base64url) which is attached to the request context. - Commitment ledger: services/commitment-ledger introduces a small append-only service with a signing key (rotatable via KMS). Entries include request_id, chosen_kms_key_id, region, policy_contract_id, signer_kid, and signature. Ledger exposes a read-only API for auditors and an expiry-based retention policy configured per-tenant. - Audit enrichment: audit/forwarder picks up commitment tokens and expands them into commitment metadata (last 8 chars of signer_kid, region, contract id hash) while preserving the original event. Enriched audit records pass through existing pipelines unchanged for consumers that don't need the extra fields. - Residency Gate: ingress/mux/residency_gate implements a fast path check for region assertions and KMS compatibility matrix. Failing checks return 403 with an explicit policy_violation code and a link to remediation docs. - Migration & rollout: feature flag rbac_policy_contracts.enabled with staged rollout; sticky migration script migrates a small cohort of tenants to the new enforcement path; compatibility shim ensures legacy bindings still resolve to prior KMS routing if the tenant is not migrated. Commits (high-level): - add(policy_contracts): DSL + compiler + examples - feat(enforcer): runtime contract loader + ledger client - feat(ledger): append-only commitment store + signer integration - feat(audit): enrich forwarder with commitment tokens - feat(mux): residency gate enforcement + error codes - docs: operator migration guide + consumer audit docs - tests: unit + integration + one flake-fix commit Tests and CI: - Unit test coverage added for DSL compiler, ledger signing and verification, and residency gate logic. - Integration tests include a simulated tenant migration with an in-memory ledger. - CI matrix: linux/amd64 unit, integration:e2e, lint, go-sec-scan. One flaky test (audit/forwarder TestBatchFlush) was fixed by replacing time.Sleep with a condition variable; CI green on rerun. Files changed (high-level): - rbac-policy-bundle/policy_contracts/{spec.md,schema.yaml,compiler.go,compiler_test.go,examples/tenant_residency.yaml} - authz/enforcer/{loader.go,binding_resolver.go,ledger_client.go} - services/commitment-ledger/{server.go,store.go,signer.go,api.md} - audit/forwarder/{enricher.go,enricher_test.go} - ingress/mux/{residency_gate.go,residency_gate_test.go} - docs/compliance/policy-contracts.md - installer/migrations/{migrate_policy_contracts.go} - charts/rbac-policy-bundle/values.yaml (feature flag) Review and feedback (selected): - Priya Rao (reviewer): "Can we avoid storing full key material in the ledger? auditors only need key id and region plus signed assertion." Author reply: "We only store key id + region + signed assertion; comments updated to clarify and added storage schema test." - Marta Alvarez: "We need explicit TTL and retention config per tenant for privacy/legal requests." Author reply: "Added tenant_retention_days in ledger config; added a migration that backfills TTL for existing tenants in the cohort." - Liam O'Connell: "How do we ensure operator-scoped roles can't escalate via policy contracts?" Author reply: "Policy contracts compile into RBACv2 constraints that are enforced in the PDP; operator roles are evaluated with a deny-first merge. Added unit tests covering operator override attempts." - Security review note (from sec-eng): "Signer key rotation must be audited; document added and rotation integrated into KMS provisioning flow." Author reply: "Rotation docs and a rotation e2e added; ledger exposes signer metadata in /v1/status." Billing/usage & telemetry: - Added metrics: policy_contracts.compiled, ledger.append.success, ledger.append.fail, residency_gate.denied, residency_gate.allowed. - Added trace spans for ledger-sign and commitment-attach with sampling tag policy_contract=true. Migration plan (operator-facing): - Phase 0: feature flag off. - Phase 1: enable read-only contract compilation and dry-run logging for 1% tenants. - Phase 2: enable enforcement for a small cohort; monitor metric residency_gate.denied and audit enrichment volume. - Phase 3: expand to 50% then 100% and deprecate legacy shim. Backout plan included. Observability: dashboards added in docs/dashboards/policy_contracts.json and alert policy: residency_gate.denied_rate > 0.1% sustained triggers P1. Security and compliance considerations: - Ledger entries are signed; access to ledger read API is restricted to compliance personas; retention configurable per-tenant; access logs forwarded to audit pipeline. - No plaintext key material stored. - Contract DSL reviewed for injection/resolution attack surfaces; compiler sandboxed. Docs and operator guide: - docs/compliance/policy-contracts.md with example workflows and remediation steps. - docs/upgrade/migration_steps.md with CLI helpers. Merge and rollout: - Merged via squash and merge after approvals. Merge commit: "Introduce policy contracts, commitment ledger, and residency gate (squash)". Notes and follow-ups: - Follow-up tasks added: ENG-8810 (policy-explain endpoint), SEC-345 (attestation of ledger signer), PM-402 enable customer-facing contract templates. - Suggested future work: compact zk-friendly proof for commitments; further KMS multi-provider cross-checks. Overall impact: This change centralizes compliance guardrails into an auditable, reviewable contract model that ties RBACv2 assertions to KMS choices and audit entries. It provides a clear, staged migration path and operator-facing controls required for region-pin and residency SLAs.
